title: Reconcile uncertain swarm side effects instead of blindly replaying shell commands
goal: P1: classify_tool_action calls arbitrary exec_command and apply_patch idempotent by name; DAG records side effects after execution and may_retry_node has no production resume caller found. Build on durable ownership fencing. Default arbitrary shell/external mutation to nonretryable unless the operation provides verifiable idempotency; persist intent before dispatch and durable receipt afterward, retain uncertain outcomes across restart and require operation-specific reconciliation or idempotency keys before replay. Wire the policy into real resume/redispatch, not only helper APIs. Add nonzero hermetic production-entry tests named swarm_gap_safe_replay_* injecting crashes before dispatch, after external effect and before receipt, and after receipt; exercise append/create/deploy-like effects and patch retries. Assert each uncertain nonidempotent effect occurs once or remains blocked for reconciliation, never silently duplicated. Preserve existing tests and acceptance records; add regression tests that fail before the repair and execute at least one test. Do not close this task merely because a helper exists or a test filter runs zero tests.
